title: Resolve mouse carrying and incoming main conflicts while retaining both feature sets
acceptance_criteria: All original conflict paths are resolved without committing the merge; both branch feature registrations, configurations and tests remain present.

Portable-body identity, custody, escape, selected targeting, shared client routing and camera behavior compose with incoming harvest, pill/storage, ingestion and activation workflows through existing shared owners.
Singularity gravity, tether and external flight retain one movement owner per route; power authorization and native fixture geometry/session assertions retain both branches' behavior.
Fresh full JVM/native checks, UI/interaction/prediction readiness, isolated client startup and packaged artifact pass; connected owner review remains separate.
manual_steps: Pick up, throw and immediately pull a mouse; compare critical/dead mice, hand-transfer escape, storage/disposal identity, analyzer and smooth held camera.
Harvest plants and use the incoming grinder, pills/canister storage and ChemMaster workflows; confirm hand contents, names, counts and cursor icons remain correct.
Check singularity gravity on controlled characters, NPCs and loose items; exercise radiation collector activation and powered airlock/device-button behavior.

argv: import json,pathlib,subprocess; assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','-u']).strip(), 'unmerged index entries remain'; json.loads(pathlib.Path('opencode.jsonc').read_text()); m=json.loads(pathlib.Path('src/main/resources/moonstation14.mixins.json').read_text()); x=m.get('mixins',[])+m.get('client',[])+m.get('server',[]); assert len(x)==len(set(x)), 'duplicate mixins'; print('No unmerged index entries; configuration parses; mixins unique')
